paragraphs.text: Fireheart is a 2022 animated adventure comedy film directed by Theodore Ty and Lauren Zeitoun and written by Zeitoun, Jennica Harper, and Daphne Ballon from a story by Zeitoun, Harper, and Lisa Hunter. It is the second film and final Independent film produced by L'Atelier Animation after Ballerina before Cinesite acquired L'Atelier. It features the voices of Olivia Cooke, Kenneth Branagh, Laurie Holden, Shoshana Sperling, and William Shatner. The plot follows a teenage girl who dreams of becoming a firefighter.
On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, 60% of four reviews are positive. The film grossed $3.7 million at the box office.
